reference: There's been a car accident on SG Highway near the Iskcon crossroads, two cars collided and one person is bleeding from the head.
There's a fire in the kitchen of my apartment on the third floor, the smoke is spreading fast and I need help right now.
My neighbor just collapsed on the stairs and he's not responding, I think he's unconscious.
There's a gas leak in our building, I can smell it strongly near the parking area, please send someone immediately.
A motorcycle skidded and fell near Vastrapur lake, the rider seems conscious but his leg looks injured.
There's a small crowd gathered after a fight broke out near the market, no one seems seriously hurt but it's getting loud.
A power line fell down after the storm near my house on Navrangpura main road, nobody has touched it yet.
There's been a robbery at the shop next to my house, the owner is shaken but not hurt.
Part of the ceiling in the old building near Law Garden has collapsed, a few people are trapped inside.
My friend is having chest pain and difficulty breathing, we are at home in Bopal.
